track.title: OpenSpore cross-link archaeology: current data model versus committed Spore evidence

included: committed campaign, dossier, package, Track D, Track O, and semantic-verification artifacts

classification_vocabulary.represented: Current OpenSpore code or committed evidence covers the bounded semantics stated here.
classification_vocabulary.partial: A bounded portion is implemented or decoded, but the original boundary remains outside the current contract.
classification_vocabulary.missing: The current source/tests do not provide the stated original behavior or schema.
classification_vocabulary.incorrect: A current or historical claim conflicts with the stronger current source/evidence and is not used as current truth.
classification_vocabulary.intentional_modern_divergence: A deliberate host-side replacement choice, not a claim of original equivalence.

asset_types.name: world-object/model-part record
asset_types.original_semantics: Distinct model/scene-part definition family; campaign CS-02 explicitly rejects CellSerializer and reports lowercase part-name identity strings plus structural vector data.
asset_types.openspore_mapping: src/assets/WorldObject.hpp:31-71 and src/assets/WorldObject.cpp:23-112; complete byte accounting and semantic extraction, but no field grammar or x/y placement executor.

asset_types.name: cCellGlobalsResource
asset_types.original_semantics: One 276-byte stage-wide tuning record; direct field-by-field serialization of cCellGlobalsResource, not a CellSerializer name/ID envelope.

asset_types.name: RW4 container
asset_types.original_semantics: RenderWare/Ravenwood sectioned container for meshes, skeletons, keyframe animation, compiled states, and textures.
asset_types.openspore_mapping: src/assets/Rw4.cpp:18-204 and src/assets/Rw4.hpp:46-80 validates the envelope, manifest, types, section extents, and BaseResource addressing; it does not execute section payloads or material/animation semantics.
asset_types.tools: tools/spore/rw4/rw4.py:1-95 is a structural oracle; it also does not decode payloads.

asset_types.name: raster/DXT5
asset_types.original_semantics: Raster envelope containing mip data, with DXT5 verified for the current slice; other FourCCs remain unsupported.
asset_types.tests: tests/test_textures.py and the current renderer smoke; exact line anchor for the current decoder is src/assets/Texture.cpp:70-113.

asset_types.name: GMDL GameModel
asset_types.original_semantics: Versioned model record with reference keys, bounds, index/vertex buffers, meshes, material IDs, material info, and animation/bone data. Current C++ intentionally supports v8/static/stream-0/trilist/u16.
asset_types.tools: tools/spore/gmdl/gmdl.py:1-279 documents the fuller byte layout but is not bounds-hardened for every real trailer family.

asset_types.name: cCellEffectMapResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Variable 8-byte header plus 28-byte effect rows; soft effect IDs and numeric parameter fields.

asset_types.name: cCellStructureResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Variable 28-byte header plus 40-byte attachment rows; on-death/on-hatch references, random-creature references, effect IDs, level bounds, and RGB color.

asset_types.name: cCellBackgroundMapResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Variable 8-byte header plus 16-byte RGB rows keyed by a geometric scale ladder; current cell-stage use samples the ramp for clear color.

asset_types.name: cCellPowersResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Fixed 8-byte power record containing teleport cost and range.

asset_types.name: cCellLookTableResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Variable 8-byte header plus 8-byte look/variant rows; current records are validated as type/value rows.

asset_types.name: cCellWorldResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Variable 16-byte header plus cLevelEntry and cAdvectEntry arrays; the world/advect relation is decoded, but world execution is not.

asset_types.name: cCellLootTableResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Variable 36-byte header plus 28-byte reward rows, including cell/table references, weight, count, count delta, and level offset.

asset_types.name: cCellPopulateResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Variable 16-byte header plus 76-byte marker/spawner rows; cell distribution and cluster references are hard-resolved against cell instances.

asset_types.name: cCellLookAlgorithmResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Variable 8-byte header plus 20-byte algorithm rows that reference look-table instances for player, NPC, and epic roles.

asset_types.name: cCellCellResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Fixed 796-byte direct cell definition record with identity, combat, AI triple, size, eat, and reference fields.

asset_types.name: cCellRandomCreatureResource
asset_types.original_semantics: Variable 8-byte header plus 28-byte spawnable-creature rows; creature IDs are soft IDs, not cell-record references.

schemas.name: DBPF v3 package/index
schemas.original_structure: DatabasePackedFile/PFIndexModifiable anchors; 96-byte DBPF header and 28-byte rows are bounded current evidence.
schemas.semantics: type/group/instance identity, extent, compressed flag, memory size, extraction, and linear identity lookup
schemas.limitations: No original multi-package manager, load order, cache, or property registry.

schemas.name: QFS/RefPack stream
schemas.semantics: 5-byte 10FB/50FB header, 24-bit decompressed size, literal/match token grammar, back-reference validation, and decompressed-size check
schemas.limitations: The Python oracle is permissive at some stream boundaries; the C++ implementation is the stricter current path.

schemas.name: RW4 container envelope
schemas.semantics: 28-byte magic, object/section header, SectionManifest, SectionTypes, section info, type-indexed data extents, and BaseResource offset adjustment
schemas.limitations: Structural only; section payload schemas, compiled states, material bindings, skeleton/animation execution, and pixels are missing.

schemas.name: GMDL v8 static prefix
schemas.original_structure: GameModelResource version 8; current documentation covers v8 and names a separate unvalidated v9 framing.
schemas.semantics: BE refCount and keys, bounds, index buffers, vertex descriptors/buffers, mesh references, material IDs/info, and texture-set keys
schemas.limitations: C++ rejects v9, non-16-bit indices, non-stream-0 mesh conversion, and undocumented material IDs; trailer is best-effort opaque after the strict prefix.

schemas.name: WorldObject 0x0F43029A
schemas.original_structure: Magic 0xABB455B7, versions 9/10, count fields, lowercase part names, vector candidates.
schemas.semantics: Header invariant, full byte accounting, part-name extraction, plausible vector extraction
schemas.limitations: Per-entry field order and placement ownership are not derived; world-object records are not CellSerializer records.

schemas.name: Raster envelope and DXT5 mip chain
schemas.semantics: 32-byte envelope, derived layer count, layer-0 mip slices, DXT5-to-RGBA8 conversion
schemas.limitations: Unsupported FourCCs, unknown envelope words, and original texture/material state remain out of scope.

schemas.name: cCellGlobalsResource
schemas.semantics: 276-byte direct record, 69 ordered 32-bit fields, float/u32 kinds, complete-byte accounting
schemas.provenance_correction: The current header's phrase 'Ghidra struct 61843 family' is incorrect provenance: committed research identifies 61843 as cCellSerializableData and 61885 as cCellGlobalsResource. The byte parser remains supported; only the structure attribution is corrected here.

schemas.name: cCellSerializableData
schemas.original_semantics: Serialization/save-load state associated with sCellGame, not the globals record and not a name/ID envelope for the direct Cell resource records.
schemas.current: No current parser or persistence implementation. CellGame.hpp:89 and CellGame.cpp:69-71 retain only a flag indicating serializable data may be present.

schemas.name: cCellCellResource
schemas.semantics: 796-byte direct record with fixed orientation, AI blocks, eat data, size, and reference fields
schemas.limitations: Runtime selection, placement, damage, and AI execution are not part of the decoder.

schemas.name: cCellWorldResource / cLevelEntry / cAdvectEntry
schemas.semantics: World population and scale-bucketed advect records; file stores strength/variance/period as floats despite SDK integer declarations

schemas.name: cCellPopulateResource / cMarker
schemas.semantics: Scale/mask/marker header and 76-byte marker rows with hard cell references

schemas.name: cCellStructureResource / cSPAttachment
schemas.semantics: Structure lifecycle references and attachment rows

schemas.name: cCellLootTableResource / cLootTableEntry
schemas.semantics: Reward table header and cell/table reference rows

schemas.name: cCellLookTableResource / cCellLookAlgorithmResource
schemas.semantics: Look values and role-specific look-table references

schemas.name: cCellRandomCreatureResource / cCellPowersResource
schemas.semantics: Spawn rows and teleport power values

schemas.name: cCellEffectMapResource / cCellBackgroundMapResource
schemas.semantics: Effect parameter rows and background color ramp

schemas.name: cCellGame state holder
schemas.original_semantics: 20964-byte global sCellGame with main pool, query pools, current world/background references, avatar index, serializable-data path, timing and flags.
schemas.limitations: Named fields and observable Initialize writes are represented, not the complete original byte layout or manager side effects.

schemas.name: cCellObjectData
schemas.original_semantics: 920-byte per-cell object with target position/orientation, transform, opacity, size/speed, model/resource identity, AI/GFX/health/flee/chase state.
schemas.limitations: CellPool has a padded ABI subset; Entity is a role/string contract superset, not a byte-compatible object.

schemas.name: cObjectPool<cCellObjectData>
schemas.original_semantics: 28-byte pool metadata, 920-byte objects, free-list head and first-word self-index/free-link behavior, capacity 4096 for main pool.
schemas.limitations: Original allocation/free call sites and all non-main pool side effects are not reproduced.

schemas.name: cCellQueryLinkedPool / cCellQueryEntry
schemas.original_semantics: 28-byte query entry with position, cell size, next link, and cell pool index; near predicate is surface-reaching distance.
schemas.limitations: Current vector arena/LIFO projection is not the original linked-pool/arena memory layout.

schemas.name: cAdvectEntry / scale-bucket rule
schemas.limitations: Selection is pure lookup; world changes and effect execution are outside the current sim.

schemas.name: ScaleDifference / damage / attack gate
schemas.semantics: Five scale classes, 5x5 non-player damage matrix, player damage branches, resource/territory/flag gates
schemas.limitations: Pure rules do not establish original live attack events, target selection, or damage application.

schemas.name: Host Mesh and renderer vertex contracts
schemas.semantics: Positions, optional normals/UVs, indices, bounds, flat color, normal-lit textured draw
schemas.limitations: Modern Vulkan interface is a host approximation; original RenderWare material cache, compiled states, fog, TCB, texture slots, and pixel behavior are absent.

contradictions.stale_claim: Campaign CS-15 prose says the opaque-accept trailer fix was replaced by a strict known-framing walk and that trailer truncation is rejected.
contradictions.current_truth: The current C++ parser validates the version-8 geometry and material-info prefix, then treats remaining trailer bytes as an opaque tail; a trailer parse failure does not invalidate the record. This is intentional for the real cell family.
contradictions.resolution: Use current source and the explicit best-effort test comment. Classify GMDL static prefix as represented and trailer/animation as partial. The old campaign sentence is historical/stale, not current behavior.

contradictions.stale_claim: src/assets/CellResource.hpp calls cCellGlobalsResource a Ghidra 61843-family direct serialization.
contradictions.current_truth: Committed research identifies structure 61843 as cCellSerializableData, the save/load state structure, and 61885 as cCellGlobalsResource. The globals record itself is direct 69-field serialization and is not wrapped in the CellSerializer envelope.
contradictions.resolution: Retain the 276-byte/69-field parser and tests, correct only structure provenance in the map, and classify cCellSerializableData persistence as missing. Do not merge the two structures.

contradictions.stale_claim: The movement dossier and replacement-status supporting prose say the plane values were never read, the current model has no movement plane, and the current implementation is still only keyboard thrust.
contradictions.current_truth: Current source and CELL-CONTRACT pin the normal as {0,0,1} from static binary data and the point as {0,0,0} at load time; current CellSim implements camera-ray/movement-plane steering with keyboard secondary bias. Runtime per-world point, original gates, and live differential remain unresolved.
contradictions.resolution: Use current source plus CS-01/CS-14 for the bounded implementation. Preserve replaced-stub/replaced-approx status; do not call the static load-time point a live runtime value.

contradictions.stale_claim: The B1 provider is sometimes described as the resource manager replacement or as equivalent to original resource loading.
contradictions.current_truth: B1 is a narrow record-bytes interface with one borrowed package provider and a memory stub. Original cResourceManager initialization, multi-package search/order/cache, directory behavior, and property serialization are explicitly outside the seam.
contradictions.resolution: Classify provider as represented for B1 fetch and missing for original manager orchestration. Do not promote the provider to manager status.

contradictions.stale_claim: Campaign CS-31 says CellAnim/effects are wired into cell_stage as a completed animation/effect pipeline.
contradictions.current_truth: The current stage has GFX preloading and static scene draw, while the semantic verifier records that animation/effect helpers are not called by cell_stage and the renderer has no pose/skeleton upload contract.
contradictions.resolution: Classify CellAnim/effect helpers as partial unit-level projections and keep original animation/effect integration missing/partial.

contradictions.current_truth: The SDK-associated name is at 0x00E82420; 0x00E82340 is only a static FUN body candidate and the alias relationship is unresolved.
contradictions.resolution: Keep the addresses separate and classify the current mapping as incorrect if the generic identity is asserted.

research_method: Read current source/tests/docs and committed original-game semantic artifacts only.

provenance.original_evidence_limit: The original binary and any live Cell trace were not independently read by this worker. Original claims are transcribed only from committed campaign/dossier/Track artifacts and remain bounded by their evidence labels.
provenance.current_fixture_limit: tests/fixtures/cell/fixtures.json and the synthetic format fixtures validate current OpenSpore determinism and bounded parsing; they do not prove original behavior.
